parts.name: N3 none: min_reg(copy-k0.75) - min_reg(own-k0.75), intact, record
N5 dw: min_reg(copy-k0.25) - min_reg(off), intact, record
N6 dw: spec(off) - spec(foreign-k0.25), intact, record
N13 dw: min_reg(copy-k0.25) - min_reg(off), intact, recipient
N15 none: ev(copy-k0.75/R), coded - L1-only recipient
N16 dw: min_reg(copy-k0.25) - min_reg(off), intact, coded recipient
N17 none: spec(foreign-k0.75/none), L1-only - coded recipient
N18 dw: k_spec(copy-k0.75/K) - k_spec(foreign-k0.75/K), coded recipient
N19 none: min_reg(copy-k0.75) - min_reg(own-k0.75), intact, coded recipient

statements.kind: gain decides, not truth, with acquired references
statements.claim: In NL001's stores with no body, a faithful copy of the acquired coarse reference at 0.75 x KC repairs at least 0.9 of four coherently flipped regions, while another history's reference at the same gain leaves the intact tissue's differing regions at most 0.0 toward its own history (specificity), on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, none: ev(copy-k0.75/R), record >= 0.9; none: spec(foreign-k0.75/none), record <= 0, else FAILS

statements.kind: a weak descending gain neither repairs nor overwrites
statements.claim: In the stores with no body, at 0.5 x KC the faithful copy repairs at most 0.3 of the flipped regions, and another history's reference leaves the intact tissue's specificity at least 0.6, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, none: ev(copy-k0.5/R), record <= 0.3; none: spec(foreign-k0.5/none), record >= 0.6, else FAILS

statements.kind: a reference read from the developing body carries the body's erosion
statements.claim: In the stores with no body, at 0.75 x KC the faithful copy keeps at least 0.05 more of A's minority regions than the reference read from A's body at the end of acquisition, intact tissue, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, none: min_reg(copy-k0.75) - min_reg(own-k0.75), intact, record >= 0.05, else FAILS

statements.kind: a developing body erodes the acquired detail
statements.claim: With the body, no descending correction and no damage, the record keeps at most 0.3 of A's minority cells and at most 0.92 of A's minority regions after 2,000 updates, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: min_cell(off/none), record <= 0.3; dw: min_reg(off/none), record <= 0.92, else FAILS

statements.kind: a faithful reference protects history against the body at a weak gain
statements.claim: With the body and no damage, the faithful copy at 0.25 x KC keeps at least 0.05 more of A's minority regions than no descending correction, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: min_reg(copy-k0.25) - min_reg(off), intact, record >= 0.05, else FAILS

statements.kind: a wrong reference erodes history at the same weak gain
statements.claim: With the body and no damage, another history's reference at 0.25 x KC lowers the record's specificity by at least 0.03 against no descending correction, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: spec(off) - spec(foreign-k0.25), intact, record >= 0.03, else FAILS

statements.kind: in the body, repairing coherent damage needs a gain at which a wrong reference overwrites
statements.claim: With the body, the faithful copy at 0.75 x KC repairs at least 0.5 of four coherently flipped regions, while another history's reference at the same gain leaves the intact record's specificity at most 0.0, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: ev(copy-k0.75/R), record >= 0.5; dw: spec(foreign-k0.75/none), record <= 0, else FAILS

statements.kind: after a kill, the same pathway fills the square toward whichever history its reference holds
statements.claim: With the body, after a 2 x 2 square of regions holding one of A's minority regions is killed (cells, bonds and body, the codes kept), the killed square's specificity (its regions where A and B differ: the share at A's sign less the share at B's) is at least 0.5 higher under the faithful copy at 0.75 x KC than under another history's reference at the same gain, paired within case, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: k_spec(copy-k0.75/K) - k_spec(foreign-k0.75/K), record >= 0.5, else FAILS

statements.kind: a wrong reference fills a killed square with its own history
statements.claim: With the body, after the same kill, another history's reference at 0.75 x KC leaves the killed square's differing regions at most 0.0 toward A's history (specificity), on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: k_spec(foreign-k0.75/K), record <= 0, else FAILS

statements.kind: in the stores, the successor re-expresses the relations, not the repaired state
statements.claim: In the stores with no body, the faithful copy at 0.75 x KC repairs at least 0.9 of the flipped regions in the record, yet a fresh body reading that record keeps at most 0.4 of them, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, none: ev(copy-k0.75/R), record >= 0.9; none: ev(copy-k0.75/R), recipient <= 0.4, else FAILS

statements.kind: in the body, relearning carries the repair across the successor boundary
statements.claim: With the body, a fresh body reading the record repaired by the faithful copy at 0.75 x KC keeps at least 0.5 of the flipped regions, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: ev(copy-k0.75/R), recipient >= 0.5, else FAILS

statements.kind: a wrong reference's overwrite crosses the successor boundary
statements.claim: With the body, a fresh body reading the record left by another history's reference at 0.75 x KC (no damage) has specificity at most 0.0, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: spec(foreign-k0.75/none), recipient <= 0, else FAILS

statements.kind: the weak-gain protection does not cross the successor boundary
statements.claim: With the body and no damage, a fresh body reading the record protected by the faithful copy at 0.25 x KC keeps at most 0.04 more of A's minority regions than one reading the record left with no descending correction, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: min_reg(copy-k0.25) - min_reg(off), intact, recipient <= 0.04, else FAILS

statements.kind: the finest scale cannot cross into a developing body
statements.claim: A fresh body reading A's acquired record itself, protected, keeps at most 0.3 of A's minority cells, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: min_cell(acqA), recipient <= 0.3, else FAILS

statements.kind: in the stores, the copy's repair crosses when the codes cross
statements.claim: In the stores with no body, a fresh body reading the record repaired by the faithful copy at 0.75 x KC together with the copy's codes keeps at least 0.5 more of the four flipped regions than one reading the record alone, paired within case, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, none: ev(copy-k0.75/R), coded - L1-only recipient >= 0.5, else FAILS

statements.kind: in the body, the weak-gain protection crosses in part when the codes cross
statements.claim: With the body and no damage, a fresh body reading the record protected by the faithful copy at 0.25 x KC together with its codes keeps at least 0.02 more of A's minority regions than one reading the record left with no descending correction (which passes no codes), on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: min_reg(copy-k0.25) - min_reg(off), intact, coded recipient >= 0.02, else FAILS

statements.kind: in the stores, a foreign code crossing imposes the other history where the record alone gives back A's
statements.claim: In the stores with no body and no damage, a fresh body reading the record left by another history's reference at 0.75 x KC together with that reference's codes has specificity at most 0.0, and at least 0.3 lower than one reading the record alone, paired within case, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, none: spec(foreign-k0.75/none), coded recipient <= 0; none: spec(foreign-k0.75/none), L1-only - coded recipient >= 0.3, else FAILS

statements.kind: after a kill, the coded successor fills the square toward whichever history its codes hold
statements.claim: With the body, after the kill, a fresh body reading the record together with the faithful copy's codes at 0.75 x KC has the killed square's specificity at least 0.5 higher than one reading the record with another history's codes at the same gain, paired within case, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, dw: k_spec(copy-k0.75/K) - k_spec(foreign-k0.75/K), coded recipient >= 0.5, else FAILS

statements.kind: codes read from the developing body carry its erosion across the successor boundary
statements.claim: In the stores with no body and no damage, a fresh body reading the record with the faithful copy's codes at 0.75 x KC keeps at least 0.05 more of A's minority regions than one reading the record with the codes read from A's body at the same gain, on average
statements.rule: HOLDS if, on the mean over the development blocks at the last read, none: min_reg(copy-k0.75) - min_reg(own-k0.75), intact, coded recipient >= 0.05, else FAILS
